test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Simran said that she had been writing a letter to the principal.

options.text: Simran said, "I have writing a letter to the principal."
Simran said, 'I have been writing a letter to the principal."
Simran said, "I was being writing a letter to the principal."
Simran said, "I was written a letter to the principal."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Simran said that she had been writing a letter to the principal.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"she had been writing" becomes "I have been writing"**
 
 
• The past perfect continuous tense "had been writing" is converted to the present perfect continuous tense "have been writing" in direct speech.
 
• The pronoun "she" is converted to "I" in direct speech as Simran is referring to herself.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• In indirect speech, the reporting verb is "said that".
 
• In direct speech, "said" is followed by the direct quote.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The first word of the quoted sentence begins with a capital letter.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"I have been writing a letter to the principal," said Simran.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "I have writing a letter to the principal," said Simran.
 
 
• Incorrect grammar: "have writing" is not a valid tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "I was being writing a letter to the principal," said Simran.
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "was being writing" is grammatically incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "I was written a letter to the principal," said Simran.
 
 
• Incorrect verb form: "was written" is passive voice and does not match the original sentence.
